text: Tell me about a time you had to prioritize two high-impact features with limited engineering capacity. How did you decide?
Describe a product you shipped that missed its success metrics. What did you learn and what changed next?
Walk me through how you would define north-star and guardrail metrics for a new B2B SaaS onboarding flow.
How do you gather user feedback before committing to a roadmap item?
Tell me about a situation where engineering and design disagreed with your PRD. How did you align stakeholders?
Describe your framework for writing a one-pager or PRD that engineering can execute against.
How would you evaluate whether to build, buy, or partner for a critical platform capability?
You have 6 weeks and one squad. What would you cut from a MVP to still validate product-market fit?
Describe the most complex bug you diagnosed in production. How did you isolate root cause?
Design a rate-limited API for a viral feature. What components would you include and why?
Tell me about a technical decision you reversed after new data. What changed your mind?
How do you approach code reviews to keep quality high without blocking the team?
Explain how you would improve latency for a read-heavy dashboard backed by PostgreSQL.
Walk me through tradeoffs between event-driven architecture and synchronous REST for order processing.
Tell me about a time you mediated conflict between two teammates with different working styles.
Why are you interested in this company and role, and how does it fit your values?
Describe how you would handle an employee who consistently misses deadlines without damaging trust.
How do you foster inclusion on a distributed team?
Tell me about a time you led a project without formal authority. What was the outcome?
Describe a failure you owned. What did you do immediately after?
Give an example of when you received tough feedback. How did you respond?
Tell me about a time you had to influence a senior stakeholder who disagreed with your approach.
Walk me through an analysis where your initial hypothesis was wrong. How did you pivot?
How would you measure success for a freemium conversion funnel? Name metrics and pitfalls.
Describe a situation where you improved a process that saved your team meaningful time.
